pages.text: $(thing)Sneak + use the Codex$() to open the Research Tree (or press the Research button here, or use a Research Terminal block - you do not need one).$(br2)Machines refuse recipes you have not researched, and many entries of this Codex wait for their research too.

Each research shows what it builds on, its $(thing)Insight$() price and sometimes items it uses up. Most end in a $(thing)derivation$(): the situation is described, and you lay out the real equation from symbol tiles, then use it to compute a number from the given values (each world has its own numbers). Hints can be bought with Insight. The $(thing)Book of Symbols$() in the tree explains every tile and how to learn it.

$(l)Your first: Quantum Foundations$() - 5 Insight, no items. The derivation is the time-dependent Schrödinger equation. Its derivation uses symbols you learn by $(thing)holding an item$() once: $(thing)ħ$() (reduced Planck constant) from $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$(); $(thing)∂²f/∂x²$() (second partial derivative) from $(item)Dilithium Crystal$(); $(thing)∂f/∂x$() (partial derivative) from $(item)Dilithium Crystal$(). With the tiles learned, build the equation, then compute the electron's de Broglie wavelength from the given numbers.
